entities.name: Chevill
entities.description: Self-proclaimed Master Hunter, an arrogant but skilled Human Rogue and monster hunter of Ikoria.

entities.name: Vivien Reid
entities.description: Planeswalker who despises Chevill; she knocked him out in a bar fight.

entities.name: Lukka
entities.description: Compleated Lukka whose monstrosity scattered Chevill's hunters.

entities.name: Ikoria
entities.description: Plane where Chevill is a monster hunter.

entities.name: Zagoth
entities.description: Wetlands where Chevill spends his time.

entities.name: Drannith
entities.description: City with the tavern where Vivien found Chevill; later destroyed.

entities.name: New Phyrexian Invasion
entities.description: Invasion during which Chevill's group was enlisted to defend Ikoria.

events.summary: Vivien Reid finds Chevill in a Drannith tavern, starts a bar fight and knocks him out.
events.quote: Vivien started a bar fight, at the end of which she managed to knock him out.

events.summary: Chevill and his hunters are enlisted to defend Ikoria against compleated Lukka, but Chevill retreats when Lukka's monstrosity scatters their forces.
events.quote: his bravado faltered once Lukka's monstrosity scattered their forces, and Chevill retreated.

relations.quote: The planeswalker Vivien Reid strongly despises him
